items.policy_name: SLIIT (Sri Lanka Institute of Information Technology) undergraduate 4.0 grade-point scale - research transcription
items.authority_status_reason: Transcribed by the C3 research team from publicly available descriptions of the SLIIT grading scheme. It has NOT been supplied or approved by SLIIT, by the client, or by Component 1. It must be explicitly accepted before generation and must be replaced by an authoritative, client-approved policy for any real use.
items.institution: Sri Lanka Institute of Information Technology (SLIIT), Malabe, Sri Lanka

sources.title: Grading at SLIIT - SLIIT Support Desk knowledge-base article
sources.used_for: A+/A = 4.0, A- = 3.7, pass grade C, E = 0.0, 12-grade scale, D pass criteria discontinued from the 2022 regular intake.
sources.access_note: Article content was observed through search-engine summaries on 2026-10-20; the page returned HTTP 403 to automated retrieval, so it was not read verbatim.
